description: Pittston, PA — Congressman Rob Bresnahan, Republican candidate for Pennsylvania’s 8th District, today announced that he is the first Republican Congressman to ever earn the endorsement of IBEW Local 163, one of Northeastern Pennsylvania’s most respected labor unions. Local 163 cited Bresnahan’s career in the electrical trades, his years working alongside the men and women of the IBEW, and his strong record in Washington fighting for good wages, apprenticeship programs, and investments that support working families.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Rob Bresnahan Earns Endorsement from IBEW Local 163 - Rob for PA
